axes.name: Ribosomal protein gene expression program
axes.summary: Categorical states differ mainly in the signed pattern of ribosomal protein transcripts, with some states also showing mixed proteasome, mitochondrial, S100, or ferritin signals.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features only; states are unordered and may mix functions; no causal or enrichment claims.

axes.name: Chromatin, RNA-processing and cell-cycle associated program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of chromatin, RNA-processing, transport, and cell-cycle-associated transcripts, with several states showing coordinated positive or negative shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; weak effect sizes in many states; functional interpretation provisional and not causal.

axes.name: Matrix, stress and secretory associated program
axes.summary: States differ in signed patterns of SERPINE1, TGM2, metallothionein, and cytoskeletal/secretory transcripts, with some states showing coordinated stress/matrix-like marker shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; mixed and modest signals; no causal regulation or formal pathway enrichment implied.

axes.name: Chromatin, transcription and RNA-processing associated program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of chromatin/transcription regulators and RNA-processing genes, with some states showing broad positive or negative shifts in these markers.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; several states have weak or near-null signals; interpretation provisional and non-causal.

axes.name: Aldehyde/ketoreductase and oxidative-stress marker program
axes.summary: States differ mainly in signed patterns of aldehyde dehydrogenase, ketoreductase, and glutathione peroxidase transcripts, with some mixed keratin or secretory markers.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; marker-based interpretation only; states are unordered and not causal.

axes.name: PDE4/cAMP and adhesion-associated expression program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of PDE4D, PDE4B, CACNA2D1, MAML3, and adhesion/cytoskeletal transcripts, with generally modest and mixed signals.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; many states weak or near-null; functional themes uncertain and not causal.

axes.name: Nuclear export, RNA processing and translation-associated program
axes.summary: States differ in signed patterns of nuclear export, RNA-processing, nucleolar, and translation-associated transcripts, with some states showing coordinated up or down shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; decoder-derived associations; direction is state-specific, not axis-wide, and not causal.

axes.name: Cytoskeletal, transport and trafficking associated program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of ZSWIM6, CCDC88A, WDR70, EXT1, and related trafficking/cytoskeletal transcripts, with several states showing coordinated shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; effects modest and mixed; interpretation provisional and not causal.
